strings.zh: 富士博士『你冷静一点,超梦。{NEWLINE}我们可是创造了你的父母！

strings.zh: 超梦『父……母……

strings.zh: 富士博士『你所说的小爱2号{NEWLINE}是我好多年前制作的克隆体,{CLEAR}当时的技术还很不成熟,{CLEAR}导致克隆体先天多病。{CLEAR}得病去世是她无法避免的命运。
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: The Amber 2 you speak of is a{NEWLINE}clone I made many years ago.{SCROLL}The technology was still immature back{NEWLINE}then, so the clone was born sickly.{SCROLL}Dying of illness was a fate she could{NEWLINE}never have escaped.

strings.zh: 富士博士『但是在制造你的过程中,{NEWLINE}我们突破了基因技术的关键。{CLEAR}现在再制造一个小爱的话,{CLEAR}她一定可以健康长大！{SCROLL}富士博士『我知道你跟我一样喜欢小爱,{NEWLINE}那就一起为火箭队效力吧。{CLEAR}正是因为有了他们全方位的支持,{CLEAR}你才能诞生,小爱才能复活！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: But in creating you, we made a{NEWLINE}breakthrough in genetic technology.{SCROLL}If we make another Amber now, she’ll{NEWLINE}surely grow up healthy!{SCROLL}Dr. Fuji: You love Amber as I do, so{NEWLINE}work with me for Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Only thanks to their full support could{NEWLINE}you be born and Amber be revived!

strings.zh: 超梦『我和你口中的2号,{NEWLINE}都是可以随意支配的试验品吧……{CLEAR}你这种人不懂得尊重生命,{CLEAR}却妄想操纵生命！！！{SCROLL}超梦『你们……{NEWLINE}必须在这里被终结！

strings.zh: 富士博士『终结？你要干什么！？

strings.zh: 超梦『哼……
strings.en: Mewtwo: Hmph...

strings.zh: 富士博士『你不要过来啊——！！！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: Stay away from me-!!!
{VAR:FF01:200}BOOM!!!{VAR:FF01:100}
Aaaah-!!! Dr. Fuji-!!!

strings.zh: 别发呆了,快逃啊！

strings.zh: 超梦『愚蠢的人类……

strings.zh: 夏伯『走了吗……{SCROLL}夏伯『唉……

strings.zh: 夏伯『一直以来我都把小爱{NEWLINE}当成孙女一样看待。{CLEAR}在我眼中她就像家人一样……{SCROLL}夏伯『我一直以为{NEWLINE}小爱住的这间实验室{CLEAR}就是个普通的实验室。{CLEAR}没想到小爱的出生和死亡{CLEAR}竟然都是这里的一个实验……{SCROLL}夏伯『这群把生命和感情{NEWLINE}当玩物的混蛋！！！！{CLEAR}我绝对不会放过它们！！！
strings.en: Blaine: I always thought of Amber as my{NEWLINE}own granddaughter.{SCROLL}To me, she was family...{SCROLL}Blaine: I always thought the lab Amber{NEWLINE}lived in was just an ordinary lab.{SCROLL}I never imagined her birth and her{NEWLINE}death were both just an experiment...{SCROLL}Blaine: These bastards who treat life{NEWLINE}and feelings as playthings!!!!{SCROLL}I will never let them get away with{NEWLINE}this!!!

strings.zh: 小蓝『那个叫超梦的精灵{NEWLINE}能因为小爱而愤怒,{CLEAR}我想它的本性应该不坏吧。{CLEAR}火箭队的人制造了超梦却无法控制,{CLEAR}最终反被杀死,{CLEAR}也算是自食恶果了。

strings.zh: 小赤『那个叫超梦的精灵{NEWLINE}能因为小爱而愤怒,{CLEAR}我想它的本性应该不坏。{CLEAR}火箭队的人制造了超梦却无法控制,{CLEAR}最终反被杀死,{CLEAR}也算是自食恶果了。

strings.zh: 超梦『Mew——！！！
strings.en: Mewtwo: Mew-!!!

strings.zh: 富士博士『刚刚那是你的声音吗超梦？{NEWLINE}真是太惊人了,{CLEAR}你居然可以通过意念与人交流！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: Was that your voice just now,{NEWLINE}Mewtwo? Astonishing!{SCROLL}You can speak to people with your mind!

strings.zh: 富士博士『在梦幻逃走之后,{NEWLINE}我们用人工推导的方法{CLEAR}补全了梦幻的数据,{CLEAR}并依据数据完成了对你的创造,{CLEAR}你的基因一半来自梦幻{CLEAR}一半来自于我们的创造。{CLEAR}说我们就是你的父亲一点都不为过！{SCROLL}富士博士『所以收起你那叛逆的情绪,{NEWLINE}好好为火箭队效力吧！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: After Mew escaped, we filled in{NEWLINE}Mew’s data by artificial inference and{CLEAR}used it to create you.{SCROLL}Half your genes come from Mew, and half{NEWLINE}are our own creation.{SCROLL}It’s no exaggeration to say we are your{NEWLINE}father!{SCROLL}Dr. Fuji: So put away that rebellious{NEWLINE}attitude and serve Team Rocket well!

strings.zh: 超梦『我知道父母是什么……
strings.en: Mewtwo: I know what parents are...

strings.zh: 富士博士『没错！无论因为梦幻逃走{NEWLINE}还是缺少基因石导致的研究困难,{CLEAR}都没有阻挡我们对你的研发,{CLEAR}你的诞生就是源自我们全体研发人员{CLEAR}对你的爱啊！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: Exactly! Neither Mew’s escape{NEWLINE}nor the missing gene stone could stop{CLEAR}our work on you.{SCROLL}You were born out of the love all of us{NEWLINE}researchers have for you!

strings.zh: 超梦『就像……{NEWLINE}你对小爱的爱,一样……？
strings.en: Mewtwo: Just like... your love for{NEWLINE}Amber...?

strings.zh: 富士博士『对呀,你和小爱对我来说{NEWLINE}都是自己的孩子！{CLEAR}所以不要再闹了,{CLEAR}乖乖听话进到精灵球里吧。

strings.zh: 富士博士『基因缺陷{NEWLINE}让小爱得了无法治好的病,{CLEAR}与其等她发病时痛苦地死去,{CLEAR}不如趁她开心时让她笑着离开。{SCROLL}富士博士『作为父亲的我做出这种决定,{NEWLINE}也是非常痛心啊！
strings.en: Dr. Fuji: A genetic defect gave Amber{NEWLINE}an incurable disease.{SCROLL}Rather than let her die in agony when it{NEWLINE}struck, it was kinder to let her go with{CLEAR}a smile while she was happy.{SCROLL}Dr. Fuji: Making that decision broke my{NEWLINE}heart too, as her father!

strings.zh: 夏伯『怎么可能……{NEWLINE}小爱她被……

strings.zh: 研发日志1：今天火箭队把{NEWLINE}传说中的精灵梦幻给捉来了,{CLEAR}真是太不可思议了,{CLEAR}这种精灵居然是真实存在的！？{CLEAR}以它为原型的话,{CLEAR}肯定能制作出史上最强的精灵！{SCROLL}要继续读吗？
strings.en: R&D Log 1: Today Team Rocket brought in{NEWLINE}the legendary Pokémon Mew.{SCROLL}Unbelievable!{SCROLL}This Pokémon really exists?! Using it as{NEWLINE}a template, we can surely create the{CLEAR}strongest Pokémon in history!{SCROLL}Keep reading?

strings.zh: 研发日志2：梦幻的力量超乎想象,{NEWLINE}稍一疏忽就被它给跑掉了。{CLEAR}缺少了重要的研究资料,{CLEAR}研发前景很不乐观。{CLEAR}不过哥哥那里的那块基因石,{CLEAR}或许能在今后的研究中帮上忙。{SCROLL}要继续读吗？
strings.en: R&D Log 2: Mew’s power is beyond{NEWLINE}imagining. One moment’s carelessness,{CLEAR}and it got away.{SCROLL}Without this vital research material,{NEWLINE}the project’s prospects are grim.{SCROLL}But the gene stone my brother has{NEWLINE}might help our future research.{SCROLL}Keep reading?

strings.zh: 研发日志3：小爱2号{NEWLINE}今天发病非常严重,{CLEAR}多个内脏器官都发生了病变。{CLEAR}看来下一个克隆体3号{CLEAR}必须要进行充分的基因调整。{CLEAR}偏偏火箭队获取基因石失败了,{CLEAR}这让目前的基因研究难以继续开展。{SCROLL}要继续读吗？

strings.zh: 研发日志4：真是太棒了,{NEWLINE}我们通过海量数据的统计分析,{CLEAR}发现了基因控制性状的核心规律。{CLEAR}如此一来梦幻2号和小爱3号的开发{CLEAR}都将是一路坦途了！
